r0089: 51.  The applicant claimed ITL 30,000,000 in respect of non-pecuniary damage.
r0090: 52.  The Government submitted that the finding of a violation would in itself constitute sufficient just satisfaction.
r0091: 53.  The Court considers that the applicant sustained certain non-pecuniary damage; it accordingly decides to award him ITL 15,000,000 under that head.
r0093: 54.  Lastly, the applicant sought reimbursement of the costs and fees incurred before the Commission and the Court, which he put at ITL 5,800,000.
r0094: 55.  The Government left the matter to the Court’s discretion.
r0095: 56.  Having regard, in particular, to the length and complexity of the proceedings before the Strasbourg institutions, the Court considers it appropriate to award the full amount claimed.
r0097: 57.  According to the information available to the Court, the statutory rate of interest applicable in Italy at the date of adoption of the present judgment was 2.5% per annum.
